functions.name: request
functions.description: Call the configured server from Betterbird itself: pages of an add-on send an Origin header that local servers such as Ollama reject. Resolves to {ok, status, body} or {aborted: true}.

payload.description: JSON to POST; GET when left out.

requestId.description: Pass the same ID to cancel().

functions.name: getDraft
functions.description: The user's own text in a compose tab: the selection if there is one, otherwise what they wrote, without quotes or signature. Resolves to {text, scope}.

functions.name: applySuggestion
functions.description: Replace the text getDraft reports with the suggestion, or insert it at the caret when there is none. Can be undone in the editor.
